summary: Deferred license reclamation and staged hardware redistribution for 2 departing engineers
description: Issue summary: HR requests coordinated reclaim of paid software licenses and staged redistribution of two company laptops for a pair of engineers leaving during a staggered offboarding window. Impact: If licenses are not reclaimed before the billing cycle renews, Finance will incur an extra month of charges and procurement capacity will be affected. Background: Two engineers on Platform team (Elliot Park, leaving 2026-03-10; and Samira Khan, leaving 2026-03-24) need different offboarding timelines. Elliot has an enterprise JetStream license and a purchased JetAnalytics seat; Samira has a JetStream license and a company SSD-equipped dev laptop that needs to be repurposed for a new hire starting 2026-04-05. HR has requested a deferred reclaim for Samira's laptop until her final day to allow knowledge transfer. Request: Create a staged offboarding plan that reclaims billable licenses on first available billing cutoff after each departure, verifies license transferability, schedules device wipe and hardware redistribution to the new-hire pool with tracking, and documents exceptions. Acceptance criteria: 1) Licenses reclaimed or transfer scheduled with vendor confirmation. 2) Financial charge avoidance (no unapproved renewals). 3) Device Wipe & Inventory entries completed within 48 hours of device handback. 4) Clear owner for outstanding exceptions and an audit trail in Confluence.
steps: 1) Confirm license end-dates with vendor portal for JetStream and JetAnalytics
2) Coordinate with HR to confirm last active access date for Elliot and Samira
3) Create vendor support ticket for license transfer or cancellation and capture vendor ticket ID
4) Schedule IT pickup for Elliot on 2026-03-11 and for Samira on 2026-03-25 (post knowledge transfer)
5) Perform MDM unenroll -> secure wipe -> attest in inventory -> move asset to redistribution queue
6) Update Confluence offboarding playbook with exception notes and link to this ticket
investigation_notes: 2026-03-01: Confirmed with HR that staggered offboarding is intentional and that Samira needs laptop until final day for pair-programming sessions.

2026-03-02: Checked vendor portal: JetStream auto-renews on 1st of each month; JetAnalytics renews quarterly on 15th. Elliot's JetAnalytics seat is not transferrable via self-service; vendor requires manual support workflow.
2026-03-02: Inventory lookup: Samira's laptop serial ends with 'K9Q2', SSD hardware tag #HW-34821. Device is on MDM group 'engineering-dev'.

2026-03-03: Preflight with Finance: if license is cancelled within 7 days of renewal, prorated credit is available but requires vendor acceptance; need vendor ticket before 2026-03-14 to avoid full renewal charge for JetStream on April 1st.
comments: Ava Martinez (2026-03-01): Filing per HR request — see HR offboarding emails for Elliot and Samira. Assigning to IT asset team to draft plan.
Noah Patel (2026-03-02): I'll take this. Initial tasks: vendor check, pickup scheduling, and MDM wipe runbook. Tentative pickup dates attached to steps.
Priya Shah - HR (2026-03-02): Confirmed dates. Samira needs the laptop for training through 2026-03-24. Please do not schedule early pickup for her.
Luca Rossi - Finance (2026-03-03): Flagging that JetStream auto-renews 2026-04-01. If we don't send cancellation/transfer request by 2026-03-14 we risk full-cycle billing for April.
workaround: If vendor cannot process a transfer in time, Finance will request a short-term budget exception to cover the one-month renewal and will process a retroactive credit if vendor issues prorated refund.
Temporary license can be provisioned to the incoming new hire from our free seat pool until the transferred license is available.
resolution: 2026-03-04: Vendor ticket created with JetCorp (VT-11294). Vendor acknowledged and requested Elliot's account email and invoicing contact. Action: HR to confirm billing contact and provide Elliot's license owner email.
2026-03-04: IT scheduled Elliot pickup for 2026-03-11. IT will perform MDM unenroll and hardware wipe same day; inventory record to be updated with 'redistributed' status.

Next steps: HR to supply billing contact (due 2026-03-05), vendor to confirm transfer/cancel path (expected by 2026-03-09), IT to confirm Samira pickup window post-2026-03-24. Revisit ticket on 2026-03-10 for status check.
